Morning team — quick technical summary and proposed credit calc (draft):

What happened (short):
- Between 18:10–22:50 UTC on Mar 19 we observed a sustained influx of long-context batch requests from Novaterra’s analytics pipeline. The requests exceeded the configured batching window which caused excessive KV cache churn and increased per-token CPU contention on the serving nodes.
- Result: median p50 latency rose from 180ms to 1150ms, p95 from 420ms to 3.8s. Error rate (5xx) rose from baseline 0.3% to 4.7% for the impacted model route.

Root causes (contributing):
- Unanticipated shift in request size distribution (longer sequences) from Novaterra during a data reprocessing run.
- Autoscaling delay due to a conservative upscale policy on the Dedicated cluster serving this tenant.
- A kernel selection path regression in our runtime under high KV churn that amplified latency once memory eviction started.

Immediate mitigations applied (Mar 19-20):
- Temporarily raised concurrency cap for Novaterra routes and pinned a compatible but lower-latency model variant.
- Enabled KV prefix caching and a short-term policy to prefer smaller batch sizes for the analytics workspace.
- Exhaustive log bundles attached for your ops team.

Commercial credit calculation (draft):
- Contract SLO: 99.5% availability and latency SLO of p95 <= 500ms per calendar month for the production route.
- Impact window: 4.67 hours (18:10–22:50 UTC). Estimated lost SLO tokens: 4.67 / (24*30) = 0.0065 of monthly SLO budget.
- Proposed remedy: pro-rated credit = 0.0065 * monthly committed fee; floor applied to ensure minimum meaningful remediation.
- Our draft calculation is attached (slo_credit_calc.xlsx) and includes hour-by-hour token estimates and cost-offset alternatives (additional capacity credit vs one-time billing credit).

Attachments: incident_postmortem.pdf (detailed timeline + logs), slo_credit_calc.xlsx (calc)

I’ll be on the exec call if scheduled; happy to walk through the numbers.

- Aditya

We can move forward on a one-time billing credit for Mar but will require a contract amendment for future recurrences.

We’re available for a 10:30am PT exec call. Please send the invite.
